facts.function: detect passing vehicles and axles for traffic counting

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9031 covers measuring or checking instruments, appliances and machines not specified elsewhere; counting vehicles is a measuring/checking function
GRI 6: 9031.80 other instruments; 9031.80.80 other; statistical line 'Other'

rejected_alternatives.reason: electrical signaling/traffic control equipment for roads; these devices count rather than control or signal
revolution/production counters, taximeters; not vehicle counting sensors
other electrical machines; heading 9031 more specific to measuring/checking

missing_facts: whether loops are separate passive wire loops (possibly 8544) and whether sensors are part of a counter or signal controller system
classification.rationale: Traffic counting sensors are measuring/checking devices under 9031.80.80; the statistical suffix and heading (vs 8530 traffic equipment) are assumptions. Cross search found no on-point ruling.
